requirements.title: IEEE_SIGNALING_GE implements signaling greater-than-or-equal comparison
requirements.definition: The result is true exactly for operands where A compares greater than or equal to B; NaN operands produce false and signal IEEE_INVALID; non-NaN operands signal no exception.

pending.IEEE_SIGNALING_GE-exact-nonnan-result: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(-0.75), IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(F,1.0) for each flag F among IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT, and, after construction, IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(pinf) plus IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(ninf) for infinity operands. Named preamble FLAG-HALTING-OFF(F,1.0): IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(F) true branch calls IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(F,.FALSE.); IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(F) false branch calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(F,h) and proceeds only with h .FALSE.; h .TRUE. branch skips. Supported branch after FLAG-HALTING-OFF(F,1.0) for each flag F among IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT: clear all five flags before each row. Signed-zero row constructs pz=0.0 and nz=IEEE_VALUE(1.0,IEEE_NEGATIVE_ZERO), pre-verifies IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(nz), evaluates IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(pz,nz) and IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(nz,pz), and asserts both .TRUE. with all five flags quiet. Infinity rows create pinf=IEEE_VALUE(1.0,IEEE_POSITIVE_INF) and ninf=IEEE_VALUE(1.0,IEEE_NEGATIVE_INF), then assert IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(pinf,1.0) .TRUE., IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(1.0,pinf) .FALSE., IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(ninf,1.0) .FALSE., IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(1.0,ninf) .TRUE., IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(pinf,pinf) .TRUE., and IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(ninf,ninf) .TRUE., with all five flags quiet after each row. Finite rows use radix-free exact literals 2.0, 1.5, and -0.75, assert IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(2.0,1.5) .TRUE., IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(1.5,1.5) .TRUE., and IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(-0.75,1.5) .FALSE., with all five flags quiet. Unsupported branch: skip.
pending.IEEE_SIGNALING_GE-nan-result-false-and-i: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID,1.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(F,1.0) for each other flag F among IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT, and, after construction, IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(qnan) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(snan). Named preamble FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_INVALID,1.0): IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_INVALID) true branch calls IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(IEEE_INVALID,.FALSE.); IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_INVALID) false branch calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(IEEE_INVALID,h) and proceeds only with h .FALSE.; h .TRUE. branch skips. Supported branch after FLAG-HALTING-OFF(IEEE_INVALID,1.0): create qnan=IEEE_VALUE(1.0,IEEE_QUIET_NAN), verify IEEE_CLASS(qnan)==IEEE_QUIET_NAN and IEEE_IS_NAN(qnan), create snan=IEEE_VALUE(1.0,IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), verify IEEE_IS_NAN(snan), and clear all five flags before each row. Quiet-NaN row evaluates IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(1.0,qnan), IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(qnan,1.0), and IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(qnan,qnan), asserts every result .FALSE., IEEE_INVALID signaling, and IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT quiet. Signaling-NaN row evaluates IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(1.0,snan), IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(snan,1.0), IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(snan,snan), IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(qnan,snan), and IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(snan,qnan), asserts every result .FALSE., IEEE_INVALID signaling, and IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT quiet. Discrimination row clears all flags, evaluates IEEE_SIGNALING_GE(1.0,qnan) and observes IEEE_INVALID signaling, clears all flags again, evaluates IEEE_QUIET_GE(1.0,qnan), and observes IEEE_INVALID quiet with the same .FALSE. result. Unsupported branch: skip.
pending.IEEE_SIGNALING_GE-nonnan-no-invalid-sign: This facet is covered by the signed-zero, infinity, and finite rows of IEEE_SIGNALING_GE-exact-nonnan-result: after FLAG-HALTING-OFF(F,1.0) for each flag F among IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT, each non-NaN row clears all five flags, evaluates the comparison, and asserts IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT all remain quiet.
